gemini.rationale: SIR's product (T4) was transferred as a subset because the ILPT asset was carved out and distributed prior to closing. SIR had no employees (T6=null), so there is no gap_56.

Both REITs had no employees and relied on RMR LLC personnel, and the same external personnel substrate continued through GOV's agreements when SIR's parallel agreements terminated, so no process-organization gap is documented at closing.
